title: Query with `subscribed: false` returns undefined due to mutation race
author: emersion
body_preview: Steps:  1. Create an API with a query and a mutation sharing the same cache tag 2. Start a request for the query with `subscribe: false` 3. Start a request for the mutation 4. If the mutation completes right before the query, the query returns `undefined`, breaking its API contract (types claim that `undefined` is never returned)  Here is a minimal reproducer: https://gist.github.com/emersion/1459...

title: useQuery refetches in an infinite loop when query args contain NaN and the request fails
author: aagostino31
body_preview: ## Versions  - @reduxjs/toolkit 2.11.2 (reproduced) - Regression introduced in 2.9.0. title: Proposal: add an explicit infinite query refetch mode that preserves cached pages
author: jtiret

title: [3.0] remove `Action` generic argument from `configureStore`
author: phryneas
body_preview: We strongly discourage any other type than `UnknownAction` for a long time now.  This being there leads people in the wrong direction, e.g. see https://github.com/reduxjs/redux/issues/4887
